name: External Verification Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external verification reason code, as published in an external verification code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

AC01.name: Incorrect Account Number
AC01.definition: Account number provided in the request is invalid or missing.

AGNT.name: Incorrect Agent
AGNT.definition: Agent identification provided in the request is incorrect

DUPL.name: Duplicate Request
DUPL.definition: Request is a duplicate of another request

AG01.name: Transaction Forbidden On This Account
AG01.definition: Transaction forbidden on this type of account (Payment cannot be made to this account for example not open for deposits, blocked, closed).

BNOR.name: Account Holding Bank Not Registered
BNOR.definition: PSP is not registered under this Scheme.

DS28.name: Return For Technical Reason
DS28.definition: Return following technical problems resulting in erroneous transaction.

MS03.name: Not Specified Reason Agent Generated
MS03.definition: Reason has not been specified by agent.

NORR.name: No Report Recieved
NORR.definition: No response on request within timeframe.

NR01.name: No Reason Possible
NR01.definition: PSP not able to confirm details and no reason is stated.

RC03.name: Invalid Debtor Bank Identifier
RC03.definition: Debtor bank identifier is invalid or missing.

RC04.name: Invalid Creditor Bank Identifier
RC04.definition: Creditor bank identifier is invalid or missing.

TM01.name: Invalid Cut Off Time
TM01.definition: Associated message was received after agreed processing cut-off time.

PN01.name: Account Owner Name Do Not Match
PN01.definition: Account Owner name and Payment Account number do not match.

PN02.name: Account Owner Name Close Match
PN02.definition: Account Owner name and Payment Account number is a close match.

PI01.name: Account Owner Identification Do Not Match
PI01.definition: Account Owner Identification and Payment Account number do not match.
